generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, restart the app.

notConfigured: This build is not connected to a server yet.
invalidResponse: The server sent a response we could not read.

codes.AUTH_INVALID_EMAIL: Please enter a valid email address.
codes.AUTH_OTP_INVALID: That code is not right. Please check it and try again.
codes.AUTH_OTP_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Request a new one.
codes.AUTH_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
codes.AUTH_PLAY_SERVICES_UNAVAILABLE: Google Play services are not available on this device. Use email instead.
codes.AUTH_PROVIDER_NO_TOKEN: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again or use email.
codes.AUTH_PROVIDER_ERROR: We could not sign you in with that provider. Please try again or use email.
codes.AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
codes.AUTH_NETWORK: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
codes.AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
codes.AUTH_PROFILE_MISSING: Your account is still being set up. Please try again in a moment.
codes.NETWORK_ERROR: You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
codes.NOT_CONFIGURED: This build is not connected to a server yet.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that in this household.
codes.NOT_FOUND: We could not find that. It may have been removed.
codes.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details are not valid. Please check and try again.
codes.LIMIT_REACHED: You've reached the limit for your plan.
codes.CHILD_DATA_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Please confirm consent for children's data before adding a child.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
codes.INVITE_INVALID: This invitation link is not valid.
codes.INVITE_EXPIRED: This invitation has expired. Ask the household owner to send a new one.
codes.INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to a different email address.
codes.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member of the household.
codes.REAUTH_REQUIRED: For your security, please sign in again to continue.
codes.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Our assistant is taking a break. Please try again in a minute.
codes.AI_TIMEOUT: This is taking longer than usual. Please try again in a minute.
codes.AI_OUTPUT_INVALID: We couldn't put that together this time. Please try again.
codes.SAFETY_ESCALATION: Let's pause here. This needs a doctor's advice.
codes.FEATURE_DISABLED: This is paused for a short while. Please try again later.
codes.PLAN_ALREADY_ACTIVE: You already have an active plan this week.
codes.PLAN_NOT_ADJUSTABLE: This plan can't be changed any more.
codes.ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING: Your account is already scheduled for deletion.
codes.OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER_REQUIRED: You own a household with other members. Make someone else the owner first.
codes.EXPORT_KIND_UNSUPPORTED: This kind of export isn't available yet.
codes.GROWTH_REFERENCE_OUT_OF_RANGE: This measurement is outside the range the growth charts cover.
codes.CONSENT_REQUIRED: Please review and accept the required consent first.
codes.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: A service we rely on isn't answering. Please try again in a few minutes.
codes.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: This is still being processed. Please wait a moment.
codes.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
